text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without even taking time to celebrate her 
Keeneland Cup victory, K.S.Miracle 
requested to enter the Centaur Stakes, 
less than a month away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on the Sprinters 
Stakes, she feels the difference in 
experience between herself and her rivals. 
That is why she was ready to push through 
even a perilous path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I was the one who set her running"— 
Accepting K.S. Miracle's resolve, the 
Trainer decides to enter her in the 
Centaur Stakes.
